topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class, recaps practical observations, and outlines the main learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Cancer and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the discovery and experimental testing of transforming viruses established that cancer arises from altered cellular genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer mutations and examine how they affect cell cycle regulation and cellular behavior.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Sequence and Chromosomal Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the differences between sequence and chromosomal instability alongside the specific DNA repair and mitotic failures that generate them.

topics.label: Multistep Progression and Hereditary Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how stepwise accumulations of mutations drive cancer progression and how inherited gene defects accelerate this process.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session by inviting questions, recommending supplementary reading, and previewing the next lecture topic.
